name: Donna Berg
source:
Donna Berg, formerly Donna Aelswith, born Donna Newhall. Mrs Berg is a powerful force in Racham, both politically and socially. She has enough money to buy an election right out from under [url=/c176673]Vincenzo Bellarosa[/url]. She, of course, does nothing of the kind since she likes a less complicated life or just plain life. Wife of [url=/c176655]Randolph[/url] and mother of [url=/c176663]Marcus Aelswith the Third (Ringo)[/url] from a previous marriage. Mrs Berg is ruthless, calculating, and self-serving.

[Edited from in-game description]
